description: This file defines an OrderRepository class responsible for managing order data interactions with a backend API in an online shopping platform. It provides methods for creating orders, fetching order details, paginating order lists, and updating order statuses such as paid, shipped, delivered, or canceled. It also contains data classes and extension functions for mapping DTOs to domain models.

classes.name: OrderRepository
classes.description: A class providing methods to create, retrieve, update, and list orders via a network API, encapsulating order-related operations.

classes.name: PageResult
classes.description: A generic data class representing a paginated list of items with total count.

classes.name: OrderFilters
classes.description: A nested data class in OrderRepository for filtering order queries based on status, email, and date range.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates an order with a list of productId and quantity pairs, with optional coupon code.

methods.name: getOrderById
methods.description: Fetches a specific order by its ID.

methods.name: fetchOrdersPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of orders, applying optional filters.

methods.name: markPaid
methods.description: Transitions an order to the PAID status.

methods.name: markShipped
methods.description: Transitions an order to the SHIPPED status.

methods.name: markDelivered
methods.description: Transitions an order to the DELIVERED status.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an order, setting its status to CANCELED.
